title: AI filmmaking & cinematic storytelling
summary: Visually coherent narrative sequences, built with generated imagery and motion in service of the story.
body: I develop visually coherent narrative sequences, using generated imagery and motion to support story, atmosphere and continuity. Concept development, shot design, character and environment consistency, pacing, sound and finishing all contribute to the final experience.

title: AI commercials, product & brand films
summary: Commercial content built around audience, product and message — not around the novelty of the tool.
body: I translate brand objectives into visually compelling commercial content built around audience, product and message. The work covers product visuals, campaign films, platform-specific edits and the creative decisions that make a commercial legible in a feed.

title: AI product UGC & direct-response advertising
summary: Creator-style product demonstrations, lifestyle scenarios and problem–solution narratives built for the feed.
body: I develop creator-style product demonstrations, lifestyle scenarios, problem–solution narratives and product-led social ads. I combine audience research, product positioning, authentic-feeling visual direction and platform-native editing to communicate benefits clearly.

title: Paid advertising & performance creative
summary: Creative built from audience, offer and placement — then refined with evidence, not assumptions.
body: I research audiences, competitors, offers and creative angles; develop campaign assets; run paid campaigns; and use performance signals to inform subsequent creative iterations. I connect the ad concept to the intended audience, placement and conversion objective. Performance figures are reported only when relevant and supported by actual campaign data.

title: Corporate & SaaS explainers
summary: Complex services and product features turned into structured, accessible visual communication.
body: I turn complex services and product features into structured, accessible visual communication. The emphasis is on clarity: a defined narrative, considered visuals and an edit that helps a professional audience understand what matters.

title: Video editing & post-production
summary: Raw or generated footage shaped into cohesive stories through pacing, sequencing, sound and finishing.
body: I shape raw or generated footage into cohesive stories through pacing, sequencing, motion graphics, sound and finishing. The edit is where the story becomes clear, and the finish is where it becomes ready for its audience.

title: AI character & environment creation
summary: Characters, settings and visual references with continuity across generated shots.
body: I build characters, settings and visual references with attention to continuity across generated shots. A reusable visual system keeps identity, wardrobe, lighting and spatial logic stable from one scene to the next.

title: Creative direction, scripting & storyboarding
summary: The narrative and visual logic behind a production, defined before generating or editing footage.
body: I develop the narrative and visual logic behind a production before generating or editing footage. This includes research, audience thinking, scripts, storyboards, shot lists and visual direction that the whole production can follow.

title: YouTube documentary & channel production
summary: Long-form editing and AI-assisted storytelling with an understanding of retention and discoverability.
body: I combine long-form editing and AI-assisted storytelling with an understanding of digital audience retention and discoverability. The work includes documentary edits, visual assets, channel support and metadata direction, with client identity kept confidential where required.
